entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I know it's sudden, but could[n]you watch the store?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I gotta head out for a bit. Think you[n]can keep an eye on things?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, were you working? Sorry to distract[n]you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I thought I'd stop by on the way home[n]from work. Partly so I could give you[n]this.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You've done so much for me, after all.[n]I wanted to say thanks.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, and I didn't get to say it at work,[n]but...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Welcome back. I'm glad you're safe.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I whipped up a little study guide for the[n]classwork you missed. It should cover[n]most of the important stuff.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If you're still having trouble with any[n]of it, you can always ask me, okay?[n]I'm your teacher. That's my job.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Anyway, I'll see you at school.
